column5: One source-shaped completion authority preserves reverse injection, silent once-only invoke or schedule, exact terminal delivery, pull-owned cancellation, and cancellation suppression. BatchCommands transport callbacks and full async RegionRequest retry policy remain external.

Per-loop mutex and condition state preserves queued execution, waiting, cancellation fan-out, exact Cancelled versus DeadlineExceeded identity, concurrent-driver exclusion, and immediate or configured spawning without another Tokio runtime. BatchCommands connection lifecycle and request retry remain external.
